newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ruggiero says China talks on WTO near final phase.
newsitem.headline: Ruggiero says China talks on WTO near final phase.

text.p: Renato Ruggiero, director-general of the World Trade Organisation (WTO), said Tuesday that talks on China's application to join the Geneva-based trade body were nearing their final phase.
But he could not say when negotiations would end.
"I hope that this negotiation reaches a conclusion as soon as possible and I think we are approaching the final phase of this negotiation," he told a committee of the French Senate.
Ruggiero said that talks were focusing on the rules under which China would join the trade body and whether it would benefit from a period of transition on joining.
But speaking to reporters afterwards, he declined to give a timetable for the rest of the talks.
"What I can say is that we have made great progress and I hope we will reach a conclusion as quickly as possible," he said.
